subject: Twinleaf onboarding — SSO/SCIM ownership evidence and role-pruning runbook
messages:
From: Alice Robinson <alice.robinson@twinleaf.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: security@twinleaf.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Twinleaf onboarding: request for SSO/SCIM role ownership and access snapshot

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. As part of our SIG+CAIQ intake and an upcoming SOC 2 audit, our security team needs a compact evidence package showing how Redwood is representing role ownership and SSO activity for our tenant. Specifically we need: 

- SCIM deltas for March 1–31, 2027 (user add/removals + group membership changes)
- SAML assertion samples for logins from the past 30 days (redact tokens)
- A role ownership matrix that maps your RBAC roles to our mapped groups and the owner/approval source
- A short runbook describing how Redwood prunes inactive roles and service accounts (JIT/deprovisioning best practices)

Can you confirm whether you can deliver these as files or via a secure SFTP drop? Also let us know any recommended retention window for the supplied artifacts for our internal evidence binder.

Appreciate a prioritized timeline — our audit window is tight.

— Alice
Alice Robinson
Security Program Manager | Twinleaf Health
security@twinleaf.com

(Attachment: none)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Robinson <alice.robinson@twinleaf.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Twinleaf onboarding: request for SSO/SCIM role ownership and access snapshot

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide everything you listed. A few clarifying questions before we assemble the package: 

1) For the SCIM deltas, do you want full CSVs of the delta stream (adds/updates/deletes) or a reconciled snapshot + delta log? We can do both but want to avoid unnecessary volume.
2) For SAML assertions, we will redact PII and tokens; are assertion samples (raw XML with attributes) sufficient or do you need a parsed attribute matrix (email/uid/ groups) as well?
3) Role ownership: do you prefer the mapping against your internal group names (if you send the canonical group list) or our canonical role ids? Sending your group list will let us produce a one-to-one matrix.

Target timeline: we can put together an initial zipped bundle in 72 hours once we have the small clarifications above and a secure transfer mechanism. Vanessa will lead the artifact assembly; Marissa will coordinate redaction and runbook drafting.

Accepted transfer methods: secure SFTP (preferred), or a shared Google Drive folder with enforced link restrictions; we can also provide an expiring presigned S3 bucket. Which do you prefer?

Thanks — sharing Vanessa + Marissa here.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Security PM, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

(Attachment: none)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Robinson <alice.robinson@twinleaf.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Twinleaf onboarding: request for SSO/SCIM role ownership and access snapshot

Hi Alice — putting the plan in writing so expectations are clear. Per Karthik: we will produce an evidence bundle containing the following files (stubs attached below):

- scim-delta-sample.csv (March 01–31, 2027) — columns: timestamp, op(add|update|delete), user_id, user_email, group_changes
- saml-assertions-202703.zip — 30 redacted XML assertion samples from March + parsed attribute CSV
- role-ownership-matrix.xlsx — maps Redwood role_id -> Twinleaf group -> owner (email) -> last_reviewed_date
- ownership-runbook.md — short doc describing role pruning schedule, JIT/temporary access patterns, service account lifecycle

We estimate 2 business days to assemble and run redaction passes.

Transfer: we can accept SFTP. If Twinleaf prefers Google Drive, please create a folder and share with sec-intake@redwood.ai (we will lock links and apply DLP). We will also provide a checklist manifest (JSON manifest) listing hashes for each file.

Retention recommendation: keep the artifacts for 90 days post-audit; if Twinleaf needs longer, we can extend retention for 12 months by request (we will note this in the manifest).

Next steps: please confirm SFTP host OR share a Drive folder URL and a contact for your secure intake team.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Security Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

(Attachments: scim-delta-sample.csv, saml-assertions-202703.zip, role-ownership-matrix.xlsx)

From: Alice Robinson <alice.robinson@twinleaf.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: security@twinleaf.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 13:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Twinleaf onboarding: request for SSO/SCIM role ownership and access snapshot

Thanks Vanessa — SFTP is preferable for us. Please push to: sftp.twinleaf-secure.com (we'll provide a short-lived account). Our intake lead is Jorge Ruiz (jorge.ruiz@twinleaf.com).

For the SAML assertions, parsed attribute CSV would be ideal (email, uid, groups, assertion_time) in addition to 5 raw redacted XMLs. For SCIM, reconciled snapshot + delta log is preferred.

On retention: 90 days is fine for the initial package. We also need to map the supplied artifacts to SIG control IDs (if you can include a short mapping table in the manifest that points the artifact -> SIG control(s) addressed, that will streamline our reviewer experience).

We'll provision the SFTP account and share creds into a secure secret manager; please call out who will authenticate with the upload (usernames) so we can audit.

— Alice

(Attachment: none)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Robinson <alice.robinson@twinleaf.com>, jorge.ruiz@twinleaf.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Twinleaf onboarding: request for SSO/SCIM role ownership and access snapshot

Appreciate the SFTP details — we can proceed. Upload responsibilities and timeline below: 

- Artifact assembly owner: Vanessa Ortiz (vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai)
- Redaction & SIG mapping owner: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai)
- Expected upload: Tue Apr 6, 2027 by 18:00 PT (we will notify when files are uploaded and provide SHA256 hashes)

We will upload to the SFTP account you provisioned under username: redwood-intake-TH4821. For audit purposes we will send the manifest and SIG->artifact mapping in the Drive link below after upload and include it in the manifest inside the SFTP drop.

Quick notes on the runbook (attached as ownership-runbook.md): it documents: periodic role review cadence (quarterly), automation used to detect orphaned roles (90-day inactivity), SCIM reconciliation windows (daily full reconcile, hourly delta), and owner escalation contacts. If Twinleaf wants a longer JIT window or custom pruning rules, we can include a tailored runbook.

I'll mark this thread as the delivery record; feel free to reply with any immediate constraints.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Security PM | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

(Attachments uploaded to SFTP and Drive: scim-delta-sample.csv, saml-assertions-202703.zip, role-ownership-matrix.xlsx, ownership-runbook.md)
